study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Brain Structural Phenotype of Autism Spectrum Disorder Using the Normative Model

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: ABIDE I and ABIDE II datasets were used. ABIDE II TD was used for normative modeling, and ABIDE I was used as the discovery cohort for ASD heterogeneity.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange (ABIDE) II ( n TD = 564) were used to generate a normative model to map brain structure deviations of ABIDE I subjects ( n TD = 560, n ASD = 496).

answer.ABIDE-II: normative training for structural model (TD); replication for ASD subtypes (ASD)

answer.ABIDE-I: discovery for ASD subtypes (ASD); control comparison (TD)

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: ABIDE II TD was used to train the normative model (GPR). ABIDE I (ASD and TD) was used as the discovery cohort to estimate deviations and identify ASD subtypes. ABIDE II ASD was used for reproducibility analysis of the subtypes.

Note: Final analysis of ABIDE I TD included 515 subjects after QC/phenotype exclusion, but 560 is the initial high-quality count.
